reviewer: Codex交叉编辑审核（非人工教师）

original_body.en: I paid for my lunch with the money from my pocket.
original_body.zh: 我用零花钱付了午餐费。

original_body.en: Dad pays the phone bill online at the end of each month.
original_body.zh: 爸爸每个月底在线支付电话费。

corrected_body.en: I paid for my lunch with the money from my pocket.
corrected_body.zh: 我用口袋里的钱付了午餐费。

corrected_body.en: Dad pays the phone bill online at the end of each month.
corrected_body.zh: 爸爸每个月底在线支付电话费。

corrections.reason: money from my pocket是口袋里的钱，不能等同表示零花钱的pocket money。

original_body.en: The winner of the school race received a silver medal.
original_body.zh: 校运会赛跑的获胜者得到了一枚银牌。

original_body.en: Every winner shook hands with the other players after the game.
original_body.zh: 比赛结束后，每位获胜者都和其他选手握手。

corrected_body.en: The winner of the school race received a gold medal.
corrected_body.zh: 校运会赛跑的获胜者得到了一枚金牌。

corrected_body.en: Every winner shook hands with the other players after the game.
corrected_body.zh: 比赛结束后，每位获胜者都和其他选手握手。

corrections.reason: 避免获胜者配银牌造成常规名次理解冲突，改为金牌。
a copy of a book常表示该书的一本，不能只解释为复制副本。

original_body.en: We found a cheap lunch near the train station.
original_body.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家便宜的午餐店。

original_body.en: This bag was cheap, but it is strong enough for school.
original_body.zh: 这个包很便宜，但结实耐用，适合上学用。

corrected_body.en: We found a cheap lunch near the train station.
corrected_body.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了便宜的午餐。

corrected_body.en: This bag was cheap, but it is strong enough for school.
corrected_body.zh: 这个包很便宜，但结实耐用，适合上学用。

corrections.reason: 原文cheap lunch是一顿便宜午餐，译文无依据添加了“一家午餐店”。
“很常”中文不自然，改为常用表达。

original_body.en: My aim is to read one English story every week.
original_body.zh: 我的目标是每周读一个英语故事。

original_body.en: She aimed the ball carefully and kicked it into the goal.
original_body.zh: 她仔细瞄准球，然后把球踢进了球门。

corrected_body.en: My aim is to read one English story every week.
corrected_body.zh: 我的目标是每周读一个英语故事。

corrected_body.en: She aimed at the goal carefully before kicking the ball.
corrected_body.zh: 踢球前，她仔细瞄准了球门。

corrections.reason: 原译“瞄准球”把被踢的球误作瞄准目标；改用aim at the goal清楚教学。

original_body.en: We had to rush to catch the last bus home.
original_body.zh: 我们得赶紧去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

original_body.en: Dad rushed dinner because we were late for the school concert.
original_body.zh: 我们要赶不上学校音乐会了，爸爸匆忙准备了晚饭。

corrected_body.en: We had to rush to catch the last bus home.
corrected_body.zh: 我们得赶紧去赶最后一班回家的公交车。

corrected_body.en: Dad rushed through dinner because we were late for the school concert.
corrected_body.zh: 我们要赶不上学校音乐会了，爸爸匆忙吃完晚饭。

corrections.reason: rushed dinner本身不明确表示做饭；改为rush through dinner与匆忙吃饭的语境一致。

original_body.en: One wheel on my bicycle is flat, so Dad is fixing it.
original_body.zh: 我的自行车有个轮胎瘪了，爸爸正在修。

original_body.en: The driver turned the wheel slowly at the quiet corner.
original_body.zh: 司机在安静的路口慢慢转动方向盘。

corrected_body.en: The front wheel of my bicycle will not turn.
corrected_body.zh: 我的自行车前轮转不动了。

corrected_body.en: The driver turned the wheel slowly at the quiet corner.
corrected_body.zh: 司机在安静的路口慢慢转动方向盘。

corrections.reason: flat通常描述轮胎tyre/tire，不是车轮wheel；用车轮转不动的明确语境。

original_body.en: I will meet my cousin at the library after school.
original_body.zh: 放学后我会在图书馆和表兄弟姐妹见面。

original_body.en: Our class met the new music teacher this morning.
original_body.zh: 今天早上我们班见到了新来的音乐老师。

corrected_body.en: I will meet my cousin at the library after school.
corrected_body.zh: 放学后，我会在图书馆和一位表亲见面。

corrected_body.en: Our class met the new music teacher this morning.
corrected_body.zh: 今天早上我们班见到了新来的音乐老师。

corrections.reason: my cousin为一位表亲，原译“表兄弟姐妹”容易误读为多人。

notes: 已逐条阅读117块的英文、中文和目标词；本文件不写入或批准数据库。
